title: Integrate Hero Section into Landing Page
description: Render the new Hero Section component at the top of the main landing page (app/page.tsx).
details: Import the HeroSection component into app/page.tsx and render it as the first element in the page's layout. Ensure it appears above any other content. Confirm that the integration does not break existing page structure or styling.
test_strategy: Manually verify that the Hero Section appears on the landing page and does not interfere with other elements. Run E2E test to ensure the CTA button navigates to '/sign-up'.

title: Test Responsiveness and Visual Consistency
description: Ensure the Hero Section is visually consistent and responsive across devices and adheres to the design system.
details: Test the Hero Section on various screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop) to confirm layout, typography, and button sizing adapt correctly. Use browser dev tools and, if available, visual regression testing tools. Confirm use of shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS classes for design consistency.
test_strategy: Perform visual regression tests and manual checks across breakpoints. Compare with design system guidelines. Fix any inconsistencies found.

title: Implement Accessibility and Performance Best Practices
description: Verify the Hero Section meets accessibility standards and optimizes performance, especially if images are used.
details: Check that headings use correct levels, interactive elements are keyboard-focusable, and any images use next/image with appropriate alt text. Ensure no unnecessary re-renders or large assets are introduced. Optimize images for web if present.
test_strategy: Run accessibility audits (e.g., Lighthouse, axe). Test keyboard navigation. Check image optimization and lazy loading. Address any issues found.
